reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis draws on established oxide-dispersion strengthening concepts, making it scientifically grounded yet slightly novel in applying them to refractory HEAs.
reasons.testability: It proposes a clear control experiment comparing doped versus undoped samples under well-defined irradiation conditions and measuring microstructural and mechanical outcomes.
reasons.usefulness: Demonstrating improved radiation tolerance via Y doping in RHEAs could significantly advance designs for fusion reactor materials, making it a highly relevant, actionable idea.
